scientific_integrity: Mathematical theorem with an explicitly specified invariant stationary law, proved analytically using finite-state regenerative dynamics; finite exact and numerical checker comparisons are corroborative only. No independence or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the golden-ratio base and independent Bernoulli digit choices on the switch interval.
Endpoint biases are limits of the open interval; the sharp variance infimum is not attained for the stated open bias range.
Previously established finite-state Markov/return-map machinery may imply the computed exact variance after further evaluation; historical priority remains uncertain.
Results concern stationary invariant digit statistics, not arbitrary deterministic starting coordinates.
title: Sharp bias-dependent digit-count fluctuations in random golden-ratio expansions
